sections.hypothesis: One-week momentum on ETH keeps beating ETH held at the same exposure on a year it has never seen: 2025-11 to 2026-10, the holdout.
sections.rationale: Watched since 2026-11-14: on ETH 2020-25 it passes every applicable scorecard test except luck (deflated 29%; walk-forward 4 of 7 windows). More tests on 2020-25 can't settle luck; unseen data can. The holdout was reserved on 2026-10-31 for one final test of a finished strategy, and this strategy has no settings left to tune. The falling-year rule comes from the 2026-11-14 walk-forward: comparing Sharpes when returns are negative scores a strategy that lost far less than holding as worse, because lower volatility makes a negative Sharpe more negative. It is fixed here, before the holdout has been looked at.
sections.rules: Implementation weekly-momentum (no settings), ETHUSDT 1d, 330 USDT. Warm-up from 2025-05-01 so the rule is running when the holdout starts; scored from 2025-11-01 to 2026-10-31. A position held on 2025-11-01 carries in at that day's mark, as in walk-forward. Run with the CLI's holdout test (kestrel holdout-test ETHUSDT --strategy weekly-momentum --research <this note> --warmup-start 2025-05 --start 2025-11 --end 2026-10), the only path that may read the holdout.
sections.falsification: Scored on 2025-11-01 to 2026-10-31 only, against holding the same coin over the same days. Earns a recommendation of pursue only if both hold: (1) the edge: if holding's Sharpe over the year is positive, the strategy's Sharpe is at least holding's; if holding's Sharpe is zero or negative (a falling year), the strategy's return beats holding at the strategy's average exposure (holding's daily returns scaled by that exposure); (2) the worst drawdown inside the year is no deeper than 50%. Otherwise Claude recommends drop and Luke decides. One year is short: a pass is support for paper trading, not proof. Run once; the holdout is never used for this strategy again.
sections.costs: Costs from kestrel.toml (about 22-23 bps a round trip), as in every earlier run. Runs on the holdout are not counted as trials and are logged.
